title: Brazil’s hypocrisy at COP30 | Science
content: The Brazilian government’s 20 October authorization of oil drilling in the mouth of the Amazon River stands in stark contrast to Brazil’s role as host this week of the 30th Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP30) (1). This decision undermines the credibility of Brazil’s climate commitments and the message the country seeks to convey on a global stage.
